lines: A blank panel with no jacks and no controls, for filling a gap in the rack
Drone voice of five sawtooth oscillators through one envelope, with a knob that first detunes them together and then has them modulate each other
Tunes this oscillator, twelve octaves from eight below C4 up to four above it
Switches this oscillator on and off; it sounds while the button is lit, despite the column being headed MUTE
Lets the frequency CV reach this oscillator; with it unlit the oscillator ignores that input altogether
Scales the frequency CV before it reaches the oscillators, -100% to 100%, so that below zero the CV is inverted
Transposes all five oscillators down together over its first half, by up to two octaves; past halfway that holds and the oscillators start to frequency-modulate each other, up to an octave deep
Holds the envelope open for as long as it is lit, whatever the gate input is doing
Sets how long the envelope takes to rise, 1ms to 15 seconds
Sets how long the envelope takes to fall once the gate closes, 1ms to 15 seconds
Shifts all five oscillators together in octaves, through the attenuverter, and only reaches an oscillator whose MOD button is lit
A rising edge switches this oscillator on if it was off and off if it was on; only the first channel of a polyphonic cable is read
Opens the envelope while it is high, and is ignored while Hold is lit or a cable is patched to the envelope input
Adds to the Volt knob, 0-10V covering its whole travel
Replaces the envelope entirely while a cable is patched here, along with the gate input and the Hold button; 0-10V, so another module's envelope output drives this one
The five oscillators mixed and shaped by the envelope
The envelope currently shaping the mix, 0-10V
Menu — FM topology: Average of active others, Circular chain — chooses how the oscillators modulate one another once the Volt knob passes halfway
Menu — Oscillator mix: Fixed sum / 5 (legacy), Average of active oscillators, Soft-clip saturated sum — chooses how the five oscillators are combined into the output
Note — only oscillator 1 is switched on when the module is added, so the other four are silent until their buttons are lit.
Note — the frequency CV input is ignored by any oscillator whose MOD button is unlit, which follows the original hardware and is not a fault.
Note — the module's channel count follows whichever of the frequency CV, gate, Volt CV and envelope inputs carries the most channels.
